user.title: SMHI Local
user.description: Coordinates default to your Home Assistant location.

init.title: Options
init.description: Update interval, warning filter and optional water data.

data_description.update_interval: How often forecast, fire and warnings are polled (60–3600).
data_description.warning_area: Leave empty for point-in-polygon (only zones covering your lat/lon). Use all for entire Sweden.
data_description.enable_water_data: Fetch nearest hydro or ocean station from SMHI.
data_description.water_source: hydro = lake/river, ocean = sea, auto = whichever is closer.
data_description.water_station_id: Optional. Leave empty to auto-pick nearest station.
